units.known_address_notes: BlockSec audit (2024-02-02) of Octopus Network's NEAR restaking contracts. The audited code is public as https://github.com/octopus-network/restaking-base (contracts/restaking-base: stake/unstake/slash_request/anchor-deposit logic matching the findings). The repo's README, build.sh and tree contain no deployed *.near account id, and the report publishes none, so no NEAR account could be attributed and verified (NEAR RPC cannot be searched by contract name).
